description: Cypher query templates for the TeachingUnit graph projection. All node labels carry the TU_ prefix to avoid namespace collision with the live doctrine graph (:base, :Concept, :Teacher, etc.).

create_constraints: CREATE CONSTRAINT ON (n:TUTeachingUnit) ASSERT n.span_id IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT ON (n:TUVideoSource) ASSERT n.video_id IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT ON (n:TUGuru) ASSERT n.guru_id IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT ON (n:TUTopic) ASSERT n.name IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT ON (n:TUConcept) ASSERT n.name IS UNIQUE
queries.merge_teaching_unit: MERGE (n:TUTeachingUnit {span_id: $span_id}) SET n.parent_id = $parent_id, n.video_id = $video_id, n.guru_id = $guru_id, n.corpus_version = $corpus_version, n.rights_status = $rights_status, n.schema_version = $schema_version
queries.one_hop_expansion: MATCH (seed:TUTeachingUnit) WHERE seed.span_id = $span_id MATCH (seed)-[:TU_CONTINUES|TU_HAS_TOPIC|TU_HAS_CONCEPT*1..1]-(neighbor:TUTeachingUnit) WHERE neighbor.span_id <> $span_id AND neighbor.rights_status = 'licensed' AND NOT (seed)-[:TU_DUPLICATE_OF]-(neighbor) RETURN DISTINCT neighbor.span_id AS span_id LIMIT $limit
queries.two_hop_expansion: MATCH (seed:TUTeachingUnit) WHERE seed.span_id = $span_id MATCH (seed)-[:TU_CONTINUES|TU_HAS_TOPIC|TU_HAS_CONCEPT*1..2]-(neighbor:TUTeachingUnit) WHERE neighbor.span_id <> $span_id AND neighbor.rights_status = 'licensed' AND NOT (seed)-[:TU_DUPLICATE_OF]-(neighbor) RETURN DISTINCT neighbor.span_id AS span_id LIMIT $limit
queries.multi_seed_one_hop: UNWIND $span_ids AS sid MATCH (seed:TUTeachingUnit) WHERE seed.span_id = sid MATCH (seed)-[:TU_CONTINUES|TU_HAS_TOPIC|TU_HAS_CONCEPT*1..1]-(neighbor:TUTeachingUnit) WHERE neighbor.rights_status = 'licensed' AND NOT neighbor.span_id IN $span_ids AND NOT (seed)-[:TU_DUPLICATE_OF]-(neighbor) RETURN DISTINCT neighbor.span_id AS span_id LIMIT $limit
queries.drop_projection: MATCH (n) WHERE any(label IN labels(n) WHERE label STARTS WITH 'TU') DETACH DELETE n
